sections.title: Primary data
sections.description: Public reference sequence and annotation only; no experimental study values are attached.

items.citation: NCBI RefSeq. Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MDS42, GCF_000350185.1 (ASM35018v1), RefSeq chromosome NC_020518.1 corresponding to GenBank AP012306.1; retrieved 2026-10-08.
items.contribution: Public reference sequence, CDS coordinates, proteins and tRNA annotations. The build pins NCBI's MD5 manifest and assembly report. This reference lacks the 51 bp mrcB-hemL insertion reported for the Nyerges 2026 MDS42 stock, so no experimental omics, growth or fitness value is attached to it.

items.citation: Nyerges A et al. Probing the limits of genetic recoding using multi-omics-guided evolution. Nature Communications (2026). doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74300-9.
items.contribution: Establishes the study-stock mismatch: the sequenced MDS42 stock carries a 51 bp insertion absent from public AP012306.1. It supplies no value to this public-reference record.

sections.title: Methods and tools
sections.description: Software and published conventions used for sequence-derived metrics; none supplies experimental values.

items.citation: Pedregosa F et al. Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python. Journal of Machine Learning Research 12, 2825-2830 (2011).
items.contribution: StandardScaler and PCA fit the reference's native codon-space axes.

items.citation: Cock PJA et al. Biopython: freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology and bioinformatics. Bioinformatics 25, 1422-1423 (2009).
items.contribution: Parses and validates the pinned NCBI sequence and annotation records.
